source.title: How SISSO-derived materials genes shape materials properties: An analytical sensitivity analysis

hypothesis: Analytical sensitivity and equivalent-descriptor analysis may reveal whether symbolic materials models are robust or non-identifiable under equivalent feature representations.
acceptance_gates: pin code, data, supplements, versions, feature grammar and domain
freeze held-out material/property families before tuning
cross-check analytical derivatives with finite differences
match seeds, candidate evaluations, runtime, memory and data budgets
test equivalent reparameterizations, correlated-feature perturbations and held-out predictions
retain false discoveries and require independent evidence for causal or physical-law claims
